maria: Quick postmortem follow-up: launching a 2-week alert-tuning sprint to reduce paging noise. Owners + deliverables below. Please flag blockers.
aj: Thanks, drop the list pls
maria:
1) Archive low-value alerts (owner @kevin) - criteria: <2% user-impact over 90d - due 2026-04-02
2) Dedupe + suppression rules (owner @tara) - implement fingerprint grouping + suppression lists - due 2026-03-29
3) Threshold auto-tune + manual review (owner @aj) - p50/p95 hysteresis + dry-run - due 2026-03-27
4) Paging policy update (owner @maria) - add quiet windows + tiered escalation - due 2026-03-31
5) RCA grouping for recurring incidents (owner @kevin) - tag families and push to RCA board - due 2026-04-05

sre-bot: Created runbook change RB-610 for paging policy updates
kevin: I'll start the archive whitelist and need alerts-export read. ops, can you grant?
ops: Granted `alerts-export-read` to kevin and tara for 7 days. Attached export steps in ticket.
tara: Dedupe plan: group by hash(metric, cluster, rule_id); will open PR with scheduled suppression examples.
aj: I'll run auto-tune in staging and post results as a changelog in the PR. Will include rollback script.
maria: Weekly checkpoint Fridays 10:00 PT. If anyone is blocked, ping me and update the Asana card (https://app.asana.com/0/111111111/board). Closing thread.
